response.guide: Fired alerts are returned most-recent-first. triggered_at and the trigger values describe the moment the condition was met, not the current market — phrase them as "as of <triggered_at>" and call get_equity_quotes for equities or get_crypto_quotes for crypto for the price now (get_crypto_quotes takes a pair symbol: construct it as the symbol + "-USD" for USD-quoted pairs, BTC -> BTC-USD, only when the symbol has no hyphen already since it can arrive pre-formed as a pair, or look up a non-USD-quoted pair via get_currency_pairs). An empty log means nothing has fired, which is a valid result rather than an error. read=false marks events not yet handled; after relaying them to the user, call mark_alerts_read with those alert_log_ids (never alert_id) so the same event is not reported twice. This log is the only way to learn an alert fired — alert events are not pushed to the agent, so never tell the user you will watch the market or notify them; they still receive their usual Robinhood notifications.
